summary: WISeQey Corp., formerly WISeKey International Holding, filed a 6-K reporting that its subsidiary WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp. completed its previously announced business combination with Columbus Acquisition Corp., a Nasdaq-listed SPAC. CAC shareholders approved the deal at an extraordinary general meeting on September 30, 2026, and the transaction closed October 1, 2026, with WISeSat.Space ordinary shares beginning trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market under ticker SAIQ on October 2, 2026. Maxim Group served as WISeSat.Space's financial advisor; Ellenoff Grossman Schole and Harney Westwood Riegels acted as legal counsel. Watch post-de-risking trading, redemptions and lock-up expiries.
